{if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Effects that Heal you beyond {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%|]{/c} Life grant you {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} equal to {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} of the overhealed amount that lasts for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds. 

You may now drink your Healing Potion while at full Life.{if:SF.IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}
